description: Domain Drop Radar: expiring, pending-delete and just-dropped domains filtered by TLD(s), length, keywords, value, quality and drop date, with presets (short-brandable, ai-names, dictionary-com, real-history, cheap-good, dropping-this-week). Returns a summary plus the top 25 with quality reasons, est. value, price, and a ready create_order body for available names or a watch body for others. For up to 500 rows call GET /api/v1/drops/full via x402 ($0.01). Page with limit + cursor (next_cursor in the response); sort with sort + order. To be alerted on future matches call radar_alert.

drops_within_days.description: pending-delete names dropping within N days

order.description: sort direction; default depends on sort

name: drop_radar
title: Domain Drop Radar search
